title: exists strict closed complement support
statement:
theorem exists_strict_closed_complement_support
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T]
    (D : TopologicalSpace.Closeds T)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (i : Y ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] [Nonempty Y]
    (hYi : Set.range i ⊆ D)
    (U : Scheme.{u}) (j : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] [Nonempty U] :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (k : Z ⟶ Y), IsClosedImmersion k ∧
      Set.range j ∪ Set.range k = Set.univ ∧
      Disjoint (Set.range j) (Set.range k) ∧
      ∃ (D' : TopologicalSpace.Closeds T), D' < D ∧ Set.range (k ≫ i) ⊆ D'. This is the exact Lean statement, with the definitions cited in stmt_deps.

source.place: support induction; stratum restriction and strict closed complement

proof.text: Use j.closedComplement. Its range is the complement of range j, giving the union and disjointness. The image of its composite with i is closed because both maps are closed immersions.
Take this closed image as D'. It lies in D. A point of nonempty U maps to D but cannot lie in D': injectivity of i would put its image under j in the complementary closed subset. Thus D' < D.
